title: Kain Wekhiyan Ae Vich Maqtil
body:
Kain wekhiyan ae vich maqtil de mera Akbar zeen toon laahnda
Ral khaak de vich paamaal theya armaan medi bhehnī da
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaya puttar di laash te kamar jhuka akhe ro ro fakhar ae nabiyaan da
Mukk noor gaya ae mendī akhiyan da
Nayi bachra nazari aaunda
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab ne Aun o Muhammad nu nayi wekhya maqtil wendiya nu
Kai waari wekhya kheemiyan choon o Akbar maqtal jaanda
